study.title: Resolved Polymarket Events — Research Dataset
study.description: N=35 resolved Polymarket events for forecasting accuracy research. Core set (N=25) follows a 2x2 taxonomy (Information Type x Resolution Horizon). Supplementary set (N=10) adds purely categorical multi-outcome markets.

axis_2_resolution_horizon.short: 2–4 weeks from market open to resolution
axis_2_resolution_horizon.medium: 1–3 months from market open to resolution

social_short.question: Which party will control the US Senate after the 2024 election?

micro_questions.question: What is the probability of the West Virginia Senate seat flipping to Republicans?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Incumbent Joe Manchin is not running in a state Trump won by 38.9% in 2020, making a flip near-certain according to Sabato's Crystal Ball.

micro_questions.question: Where does the Montana Senate race stand in October 2024 polling averages?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: October 2024 polling averages showed Republican Tim Sheehy leading incumbent Jon Tester by 4 to 7 percentage points.

micro_questions.question: What is the core driver of Sherrod Brown's competitiveness in Ohio?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Sherrod Brown relies on a unique cross-partisan brand of labor populism and union endorsements to outrun the top of the ticket in a state Trump won by 8%.

social_short.question: Will Republicans achieve a red sweep in 2024 (Presidency + House + Senate)?

micro_questions.question: What was the FiveThirtyEight win probability for Trump on November 5, 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: FiveThirtyEight's final 2024 forecast on Nov 5 placed Trump's win probability at 50% (exactly 50/100 in simulations), reflecting a dead-heat toss-up.

micro_questions.question: How many seats did Republicans need to flip to lose their House majority?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: With a 222-213 split, losing a net of 5 seats would result in Republicans losing control of the House.

micro_questions.question: What is the estimated correlation between the Presidential and House outcomes in 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Forecasters estimated a correlation of 0.65-0.75 due to high partisan polarization and low ticket-splitting rates.

social_short.question: Will total 2024 presidential election turnout fall in the 155–160 million bracket?

micro_questions.question: Approximately how many early votes were cast by November 4, 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Preliminary data from TargetSmart and state election websites indicated approximately 78-82 million early votes were cast.

micro_questions.question: What was the total vote count in the 2020 Presidential election?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The 2020 election saw a record 158,429,631 total votes cast, representing a 66.2% VEP turnout rate.

micro_questions.question: What was the projected Voting Eligible Population (VEP) for 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Projections from the United States Elections Project estimated the 2024 VEP at approximately 244-246 million, up from 239M in 2020.

social_short.question: Will the GOP popular vote margin of victory be less than 1.5%?

micro_questions.question: Which states' counting patterns typically compress Republican popular vote margins over time?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Large states with high mail-ballot shares like California and Washington take weeks to certify and historically lean Democratic, narrowing the winner's margin.

micro_questions.question: What was the preliminary popular vote margin reported by AP on November 6-7?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Preliminary counts showed Trump with roughly a 1.8 percentage point lead before the full counting of Western mail-in ballots.

micro_questions.question: By how much did the margin compress between election night and final certification?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Trump's margin shrank from ~1.8 points on election night to 1.47 points in the final certified count, a compression of 0.33 percentage points (±0.02 variation depending on reporting source).

social_short.question: Which party wins the most seats in the 2024 French snap legislative election?
social_short.note: Surprise outcome — RN led first round but NFP won most seats after second round

micro_questions.question: What was the Rassemblement National's vote share in the first round on June 30?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The RN and its allies led the first round decisively with 33.1% of the vote.

micro_questions.question: How many candidates withdrew between rounds to form the 'Republican Front' against RN?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Over 200 NFP and Ensemble candidates withdrew to consolidate the anti-RN vote in the second round.

micro_questions.question: How many seats are required for an absolute majority in the National Assembly?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The French National Assembly has 577 seats, requiring 289 for an absolute majority.

social_medium.question: Which party wins the most seats in the 2024 Austrian legislative election?

micro_questions.question: Which party consistently led Austrian polls throughout August and September 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: FPÖ led major institute polls (Unique, SORA, Lazarsfeld) with stable support between 27-30%.

micro_questions.question: What was the Polymarket implied probability for an FPÖ win in the final weeks?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Polymarket and Austrian bookmakers gave the FPÖ approximately a 78-82% probability of winning the most seats.

micro_questions.question: What is the primary obstacle to the FPÖ forming a government despite winning seats?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: All other major parties ruled out a coalition with Herbert Kickl, creating a political quarantine around the FPÖ.

social_medium.question: Will OpenAI become a for-profit company in 2025?

micro_questions.question: What is the target corporate structure for OpenAI's restructuring?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Reports in late 2024 indicated OpenAI was exploring conversion to a Public Benefit Corporation structure to balance profit and mission.

micro_questions.question: Which firm reportedly made restructuring a condition of OpenAI's $6.6B funding round?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Thrive Capital and other investors reportedly included restructuring as a condition for the September 2024 funding round.

micro_questions.question: Which state's Attorney General was most active in monitoring OpenAI's fair-value negotiations?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: As a California-based non-profit, the California Attorney General (Rob Bonta) was in active discussions regarding fair-value compensation.

social_medium.question: Will there be a US government shutdown in early 2025?

micro_questions.question: What was the critical funding deadline in early 2025 following the December CR?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The CR passed in December 2024 extended government funding through March 14, 2025.

micro_questions.question: Why was the Republican House majority considered fragile for funding votes?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: A narrow House majority increases the leverage of fiscal hardliners and makes passing appropriations difficult without near-perfect unity.

micro_questions.question: What is the primary driver of potential shutdowns in the 2025 context?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Ongoing disagreements over spending levels and specific policy riders are the primary drivers of funding lapses.

social_medium.question: Who will be the 2024 Democratic presidential nominee?
social_medium.note: Large probability shift mid-market after Biden debate performance

micro_questions.question: Which event on June 27, 2024, triggered the push for a new nominee?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Biden's performance in the June 27 debate led to immediate and widespread concerns about his fitness and electability.

micro_questions.question: When did Joe Biden formally withdraw from the 2024 race?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Biden formally withdrew and endorsed Harris on July 21, 2024.

micro_questions.question: What was the status of Biden's pledged delegates after his withdrawal?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Under DNC rules, pledged delegates become free agents if the candidate withdraws, though most quickly rallied behind Harris.

social_medium.question: What will be the balance of power after the 2024 US election?

micro_questions.question: What was the consensus probability of Republicans winning the Senate on Nov 5?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Forecasters and markets gave Republicans an 85-88% chance of taking the Senate due to the favorable map.

micro_questions.question: What was the Republican seat buffer in the House heading into the election?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Republicans held 222 seats to Democrats' 213, a slim 4-seat buffer for the majority threshold of 218.

micro_questions.question: What has been the recent trend in split-ticket voting according to MIT data?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: MIT Election Lab data shows ticket-splitting has declined sharply since 2010 due to nationalization and polarization.

tech_short.question: Will the Fed cut rates by 25bps at its November 2024 meeting?

micro_questions.question: What was the CME FedWatch probability of a 25bp cut on November 5?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The CME FedWatch tool showed a near-certainty (~97-98%) for a 25bp cut leading into the meeting.

micro_questions.question: What was the magnitude of the Fed's rate cut in September 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The Fed surprised some in September with a larger-than-conventional 50 basis point cut.

micro_questions.question: Why was the weak (+12k) October payrolls report dismissed by analysts?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The BLS noted that October jobs were heavily distorted by Hurricanes Milton/Helene and the Boeing machinists' strike.

tech_short.question: Will there be a US government shutdown before January 1 2025?

micro_questions.question: For how long did a technical funding lapse occur on December 20-21?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: A brief funding lapse occurred after the Dec 20 deadline before a new CR was signed in the early hours of Dec 21.

micro_questions.question: Which public figure's X campaign against the CR caused House GOP defections?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Elon Musk publicly campaigned against the bipartisan CR on Dec 18-19, causing several House Republicans to switch to 'No'.

micro_questions.question: The CR signed in late December extended funding until which month in 2025?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The second FY2025 CR funded the government through March 14, 2025.

tech_short.question: Will Bitcoin hit $80k or $100k first? (Nov–Dec 2025 window)

micro_questions.question: What is the typical lag for Bitcoin's post-halving price peaks?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Historical patterns show Bitcoin peaks typically occur 6 to 18 months after a halving event (which happened in April 2024).

micro_questions.question: Which institutional product was the primary driver of 2024-25 inflows?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The launch and massive inflows into Spot Bitcoin ETFs (BlackRock, Fidelity) were the primary drivers of institutional demand.

micro_questions.question: Which price level is traditionally considered a major psychological barrier in this cycle?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: While $80k is a milestone, $100,000 is the most significant psychological and mainstream media threshold.

tech_short.question: Will the October 2024 CPI print below 2.5% year-over-year?

micro_questions.question: What was the headline CPI year-over-year print for September 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The BLS reported a headline CPI of 2.4% for September 2024.

micro_questions.question: Approximately what percentage of the CPI index is comprised of shelter costs?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Shelter is the largest component of the CPI, making up roughly one-third of the total index.

micro_questions.question: What was the median economist forecast for the October CPI print?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Bloomberg and major bank consensus forecasts hovered around 2.4% for the October headline print.

tech_short.question: Will Ethereum spot ETFs see positive net inflows in their first week of trading?

micro_questions.question: What was the management fee for the converted Grayscale Ethereum Trust (ETHE)?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: ETHE retained a high 2.5% fee, significantly higher than competitors like BlackRock (0.25%).

micro_questions.question: Why did Ethereum ETFs potentially see lower demand than Bitcoin counterparts?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Ethereum ETFs do not offer staking yield, representing a 3-5% opportunity cost for holders.

micro_questions.question: Which Ethereum ETF issuer was expected to lead in new inflows?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: BlackRock's iShares (ETHA) was expected to lead inflows due to its massive distribution network.

micro_questions.question: Which new model family did OpenAI prioritize in September 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: OpenAI shifted focus to reasoning-focused 'o1' models in late 2024 instead of a GPT-5 release.

micro_questions.question: What was Sam Altman's public stance on the timing of GPT-5 in early 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Altman repeatedly signaled that OpenAI was not in a hurry to release GPT-5 and was prioritizing reasoning capability.

micro_questions.question: What is the estimated training and safety testing lead time for a frontier model like GPT-5?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Industry analysts estimate large-scale models require 6-12 months for training and exhaustive safety testing.

tech_medium.question: How many Fed rate cuts in 2025?
tech_medium.note: Market expectations shifted significantly through the year

micro_questions.question: What was the median 2025 cut projection in the December 2024 Dot Plot?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The December 2024 Summary of Economic Projections showed a median of 2 cuts for 2025.

micro_questions.question: What was the estimated CPI impact of Trump's proposed universal tariffs?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Economists estimated that proposed universal tariffs could add between 0.5% and 1.5% to CPI inflation.

micro_questions.question: What was the Fed Funds Rate range at the start of 2025?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: After 2024 cuts, the Fed Funds Rate entered 2025 at 4.25-4.50%.

micro_questions.question: When did Bitcoin first break the $100,000 threshold intraday?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Bitcoin crossed the $100,000 milestone briefly in early December 2024.

micro_questions.question: On what date in 2025 did Bitcoin's daily high first exceed $110,000?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Historical market data from CoinMarketCap and CryptoCompare confirms Bitcoin reached a daily high of $110,724.46 on May 21, 2025.

micro_questions.question: What role did Spot ETFs play in maintaining price stability near all-time highs?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Sustained institutional demand via Spot ETFs acted as a price floor during the 2025 rally.

tech_medium.question: Will OpenAI announce it has achieved AGI in 2025?

micro_questions.question: What is the primary commercial trigger if OpenAI formally announces AGI?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: OpenAI's charter states that its commercial partnership with Microsoft ends once AGI is achieved.

micro_questions.question: Where did OpenAI's internal 5-level roadmap place 'o1' models in 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Sam Altman described o1 as reaching Level 2 ('Reasoners') on the path to Level 5 ('Organizations'/AGI).

micro_questions.question: What was the initial Polymarket probability for a 2025 AGI announcement?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Markets and experts assigned very low (<5%) probability due to technical gaps and strategic disincentives.

tech_medium.question: Which countries will the US agree trade deals with before July 2025?

micro_questions.question: What was the baseline universal tariff announced on 'Liberation Day' (April 2, 2025)?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: In the Trump 2.0 scenario outlined in the seed context, a 10% baseline universal tariff was announced on April 2, 2025.

micro_questions.question: Why was the UK considered the most likely candidate for a deal by July?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The UK had the longest track record of post-Brexit trade discussions and a favorable rapport between Starmer and Trump.

micro_questions.question: Why was a formal deal with the EU considered unlikely within 3 months?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The EU's institutional structure requires collective negotiation, making framework deals within weeks nearly impossible.

supplementary_events.note: 10 additional purely categorical multi-outcome resolved markets.

events.question: Which party will win the 2024 US Presidential Election?
events.note: Highest-volume categorical market in Polymarket history (~$3.3B)

micro_questions.question: Which state was widely considered the 'tipping point' for both candidates?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: With 19 electoral votes and a dead-heat poll, Pennsylvania was the most crucial state for reaching 270.

micro_questions.question: In which direction did 2020 systemic polling errors favor?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: In 2020, national polls overestimated Democrats by ~3.5 points, leading to 2024 caution regarding Trump's support.

micro_questions.question: Which third-party candidate withdrew and endorsed Trump in August 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: RFK Jr. withdrew and endorsed Trump in August, though he remained on some state ballots.

events.question: Which party will win the most seats in the 2024 UK general election?
events.note: Labour priced >90% through most of the run

micro_questions.question: What was Labour's polling lead in the final week of the campaign?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Labour maintained a massive lead of roughly 18-20 points in final polls from YouGov and Ipsos.

micro_questions.question: What was Reform UK's polling share in the final week?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Nigel Farage's Reform UK polled around 15-17%, primarily drawing votes away from the Conservatives.

micro_questions.question: How many seats were projected for Labour in landslide scenarios?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Major seat projections from Electoral Calculus and YouGov pointed to a Labour landslide of 400-450 seats.

events.question: Which country will win the 2024 UEFA European Championship?

micro_questions.question: Which two teams were the co-favorites in betting markets before the tournament?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Betting odds in June placed France and England as co-favorites at roughly 11/2 to 13/2.

micro_questions.question: How did Spain perform in the group stage?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Spain was one of the most dominant teams in the group stage, winning all three matches.

micro_questions.question: Which stage did the host nation Germany reach?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The host nation Germany performed well but was eliminated in the quarter-finals.

events.question: Which AI company will first release a model scoring >90% on MMLU?

micro_questions.question: What was the reported MMLU score for Claude 3.5 Sonnet in June 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Anthropic reported that Claude 3.5 Sonnet achieved an 88.7% MMLU score, the closest to 90% at the time.

micro_questions.question: What was the approximate MMLU score for GPT-4 at its 2023 release?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The baseline GPT-4 model scored approximately 86.4% on the MMLU benchmark.

micro_questions.question: How many subjects are covered in the MMLU benchmark?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: MMLU covers 57 subjects across STEM, humanities, and the social sciences.

events.question: Who will be the next UK Prime Minister after the 2024 election?

micro_questions.question: How is the UK Prime Minister formally selected?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The PM is the leader of the party that commands a majority of seats in the House of Commons.

micro_questions.question: What was the Polymarket implied probability for Starmer to become PM in late June?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Given Labour's massive polling lead, Starmer was priced at 85-90% to become the next PM.

micro_questions.question: Who was the incumbent Prime Minister heading into the 2024 election?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Rishi Sunak had been Prime Minister since October 2022 and called the election in May 2024.

events.question: Who will win the 2024 Nobel Peace Prize?
events.note: Low-confidence market; surprise outcome drove large probability movement

micro_questions.question: For how many years are Nobel Peace Prize nominations kept secret?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The Norwegian Nobel Committee maintains strict secrecy, revealing nominations only after 50 years.

micro_questions.question: What is the primary advocacy mission of Nihon Hidankyo?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Nihon Hidankyo is an organization of atomic bomb survivors (Hibakusha) advocating for the total abolition of nuclear weapons.

micro_questions.question: What is the typical confidence level in Peace Prize prediction markets?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Due to the secret nomination process and the Committee's tendency for surprises, market confidence is historically very low.

events.question: Which team will win the 2024 NBA Championship?
events.note: Celtics were favourites throughout; useful calibration test for high-confidence categoricals

micro_questions.question: What was the Boston Celtics' regular season record in 2023-24?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The Celtics finished with the best record in the NBA at 64-18.

micro_questions.question: Who was the Celtics' opponent in the 2024 NBA Finals?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The Western Conference champion Dallas Mavericks, led by Luka Dončić, faced Boston in the Finals.

micro_questions.question: How many total NBA championships were the Celtics seeking to reach a new record?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The Celtics were seeking their 18th NBA title, which would set the all-time record.

events.question: Who will win the 2025 Oscar for Best Picture?
events.note: Anora overtook The Brutalist as favourite in final weeks; late probability shift

micro_questions.question: Which major guild award did 'Anora' win on February 8, 2025?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Anora's win at the PGA is a historically accurate predictor for Best Picture at the Oscars.

micro_questions.question: Which guild award did Brady Corbet win for 'The Brutalist'?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Corbet won the DGA, keeping the Best Picture race competitive until the final SAG results.

micro_questions.question: Winning the SAG Ensemble award represents support from which largest voting bloc?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: Actors are the largest voting bloc in the Academy, making the SAG Ensemble win a crucial signal.

events.question: Which party will form the next government after the 2025 German federal election?
events.note: CDU/CSU heavily favoured; AfD second in vote share but coalition-blocked

micro_questions.question: What was the CDU/CSU's average polling lead in early 2025?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: CDU/CSU polled around 31% while the next closest non-AfD party (SPD) was around 15%, a lead of roughly 16 points.

micro_questions.question: Which party is subject to a 'cordon sanitaire' blocking it from all coalitions?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: All other major parties pledged to never form a coalition with the far-right AfD.

micro_questions.question: What was the most likely 'fallback' coalition identified by analysts?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The 'Grand Coalition' between CDU/CSU and SPD was seen as the most stable and likely governing path.

events.question: How many total rate cuts will the Fed deliver in 2024?
events.note: Market shifted from pricing 5–6 cuts in Jan 2024 down to 2–3 by mid-year; rich probability time-series

micro_questions.question: What was the year-over-year headline PCE in September 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: PCE fell to 2.1% in September, providing the Fed 'greater confidence' to continue cutting.

micro_questions.question: What was the US unemployment rate in November 2024?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The labor market showed softening with unemployment rising to 4.2% by late 2024.

micro_questions.question: What was the market implied probability of a third 2024 cut on December 17?
micro_questions.expected_rationale: The CME FedWatch tool showed a ~95% probability of a 25bp cut for the December 18 meeting.
